cards.text: Israel's on the move again, friend. They camp in the plains of Moab near the Jordan, across from Jericho. And Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, has seen ALL that Israel did to the Amorites.

cards.question: Israel has just beaten the Amorites and is now camped in the plains of Moab. Moab is ___ of these people.

cards.text: So Moab tells the elders of Midian, "This horde will devour everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field."
So King Balak sends messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor, a diviner (Joshua 13:22). This king is calling in a professional.

cards.question: Balak's messengers set out to find Balaam the diviner. Where does Balaam live?

cards.text: Balak's message says a people has come out of Egypt: "They cover the face of the land and have settled next to me." Friend, that's a man peeking through the blinds at his new neighbors ALL DAY.

cards.question: So what does King Balak want Balaam to come and do to this people?
Balak tells Balaam he's sure his army can beat this people without any help.

cards.text: So the elders of Moab and Midian head out with the fees for divination in hand. They did NOT come all that way for a free estimate.

cards.question: The elders tell Balaam everything King Balak said. Balaam tells them to spend the night, so he can give them the answer the LORD speaks to him.

cards.text: Then God comes to Balaam and asks, "Who are these men with you?" And Balaam tells God Balak's message: come and curse this people for me.

cards.question: God tells Balaam not to go with Balak's men. He says Balaam is not to curse this people, because they are ___.
The next morning, Balaam tells Balak's princes that the LORD has refused to let him go with them.

cards.text: The princes go back to Balak and say, "Balaam refused to come with us." Not a word about the LORD refusing.
So Balak sends other princes, MORE of them, and more distinguished than the first. If the first batch doesn't do it, send a bigger batch with FANCIER sprinkles.

cards.question: The new princes bring King Balak's message to Balaam. What does Balak promise him this time?

answers.text: To give him half of Moab

cards.question: Balaam says that even if Balak gave him his house full of silver and gold, he could not go beyond the ___ of the LORD his God.

cards.text: Then Balaam asks them to stay overnight like the others did, so he can find out what else the LORD has to tell him. Friend, this man's guest room stays BOOKED.

cards.question: That night God comes to Balaam again. What does God tell him this time?

answers.text: Go with them but do only what I say
Send these men home for good
Stay here and bless Moab instead

cards.text: So in the morning Balaam saddles his donkey and heads out with the princes of Moab. Saddle up, friend, because we're riding along.

cards.question: Balaam is on the road with the princes of Moab. God's anger is kindled because Balaam is going along.

cards.text: And the angel of the LORD stands in the road to oppose him. Balaam's riding along on his donkey, his two servants with him, just cruising.

cards.question: Balaam's donkey sees the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand. What does she do?

cards.text: So Balaam beats her to get her back on the path. Then the angel of the LORD stands in a narrow passage between two vineyards, with walls on either side.

cards.question: Between the vineyard walls, the donkey sees the angel of the LORD again. She presses herself against a wall and crushes Balaam's ___ against it.

cards.text: So Balaam beats her once again. Then the angel moves on ahead to a narrow place with no room to turn right or left.

cards.question: No room to turn right or left, and the donkey sees the angel of the LORD one more time. What does she do?

cards.text: Balaam is FURIOUS, and he beats her with his staff.

cards.question: Balaam has just beaten his donkey a third time. Then the LORD does something nobody expects. What is it?

answers.text: He sends a storm on the road

cards.text: And the donkey SPEAKS, friend. I spent years in a junk drawer where the dead batteries argued all night, and even I did NOT see a talking donkey coming.

cards.question: The donkey asks Balaam, "What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times?" What does Balaam tell her?

answers.text: You have made a fool of me
Who taught you how to speak

cards.text: Then Balaam tells her that if he had a sword in his hand, he would kill her right now.

cards.question: The donkey asks Balaam if she has ever treated him this way before, and Balaam says yes.
Then the LORD opens Balaam's eyes, and he sees the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand. Balaam bows low and falls ___.

cards.text: The angel of the LORD asks him, "Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out to oppose you, because your way is perverse before me."

cards.question: The angel says the donkey saw him and turned away these three times. What does he say would have happened if she hadn't?

answers.text: He would have killed the donkey
He would have let Balaam pass

cards.question: So the donkey saved Balaam's life. Balaam's first words back to the angel of the LORD are: I have ___.
Balaam offers to go back home if this is displeasing to the angel. The angel of the LORD tells him to go with the men, but to speak only what the angel tells him.

cards.text: So Balaam goes with the princes of Balak. Keep your apron on, friend, because this story is just getting warmed up.
